rules.note: Valid passport. If you live in the UAE, also upload a valid UAE visa and your UAE national ID card.
Passport-style photograph on a white background.
Certified copy of your bachelor's and/or master's certificate, as applicable.
Official transcript that shows the grading scale.
Statement of Purpose of 500 to 1,000 words.
Research Statement of 500 to 1,000 words: your research interests, relevant experience and an example project you would like to join. PhD applicants only.
Two referee recommendations, submitted through an online form.
IELTS, TOEFL or EmSAT result. Upload it even if you think you qualify for an exemption. TOEFL scores can be sent directly with code 0960.
GRE score report where required (KU code 0822). Required for direct PhD applicants without a master's degree.
Equivalency certificate from the UAE Ministry of Education, for degrees earned outside the UAE.
